title: Vouchers — IOU Exposure

panels.title: Outstanding IOUs
panels.description: merchant_id column granted to cashu_mint_grafana_ro is NULL because identity columns are excluded from the GRANT (Clarifications Q4). For per-row merchant lookup, use the FR-009 admin forensic endpoint.

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.iou_id, i.policy_profile, vf.amount, i.iou_due_at, CASE WHEN i.iou_due_at < now() THEN 'overdue' WHEN i.iou_due_at < now() + interval '7 days' THEN 'due_soon' ELSE 'ok' END AS status FROM merchant_iou_funding i JOIN voucher_funding vf ON vf.funding_id = i.funding_id JOIN voucher_quote q ON q.funding_id = i.funding_id AND q.lifecycle_state = 'ISSUED' ORDER BY i.iou_due_at ASC LIMIT 200

panels.title: IOU policy drift (issued under DENY-now profile)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rogue_iou_count FROM merchant_iou_funding WHERE policy_profile IN ('prod', 'staging')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vf.amount), 0) AS overdue_value FROM merchant_iou_funding i JOIN voucher_funding vf ON vf.funding_id = i.funding_id WHERE i.iou_due_at < now()

description: Outstanding and overdue merchant IOUs, and IOU issuance under a DENY policy profile. Reads the mint database directly.
